test_healthcheck: test the healthcheck endpoint by polling /healthcheck and verifying a 200 status with 'ok' in the response
poll_endpoint: poll an API endpoint with retries until the expected HTTP status code is received
get_request: send an HTTP GET request to a relative URL on a specified server base URL
post_request: send an HTTP POST request with optional JSON body and headers to a relative URL
poll_parquet: poll the /parquet endpoint for a dataset, retrying until processing completes or an error occurs
